comment: Advisories the audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) tolerates, and only
because no upstream fix exists yet. Every entry must be dev-only, must
carry an expiry, and is re-checked on each run: the gate fails if an
entry expires, if the advisory starts affecting a production dependency,
or if it stops matching (upstream shipped a fix — delete the entry).
This file is not a way to silence a fixable finding. If `npm audit` can
resolve it with an override or an upgrade, do that instead.
